name: natural-light-portraits
title: 4 ways to shoot portraits in natural light
subtitle: no flash, no reflectors
secrets: Step into **open shade** — a porch, the north side of a wall. The light arrives soft and even, and nobody squints into the lens.
Drop **-0.7 EV** and protect the bright end. Lifting a shadow later costs a little noise; a blown-out cheek is simply gone.
Put your subject **one metre** from a pale wall and let it bounce. It fills the shadows under the eyes with no kit at all.
Wide open, **one eyelash** is sharp and the rest isn't. At f/2.8 both eyes hold focus and the background still falls away.
cta_q: Which place do you keep going back to shoot?
